title: Soft Actor-Critic with Attractor-Field PSO Parameter Adaptation for UAV Path Planning
claim: AFSACPSO is the proposed attractor-field control-interface design; under frozen-policy deployment it remains competitive with the matched global SAC controller, while the global variant is the strongest retained external deployment row in the current benchmark.
notes: Code path patched on 2026-04-02 so that the external paper comparison groups `rlbased` and `others` now use `SACPSO-Global` rather than attractor-field `AFSACPSO`.
This manifest defines the reproducibility command path; fresh paper tables and figures still need to be regenerated after the launcher patch.
Attractor-field `AFSACPSO` remains the proposed method and should be reported through the same-backbone ablation workflow rather than as the external benchmark row.
